description: System statistics and optional hardware sensor monitoring in the Windows taskbar.
notes: Uses the official portable ZIP, not the current-user setup EXE.
The portable package and SHA-256 were verified by the kirobucket candidate-inspection workflow.
Windows 11 x64 is the upstream-supported platform; Windows 10 and ARM64 are unverified.

CPU temperature is optional. Enabling it installs the official PawnIO sensor driver and a background sensor service under Program Files with an administrator prompt. Disable CPU temperature and remove the sensor service from Win Stats Settings before uninstalling if that feature was enabled.
Settings are stored under %LOCALAPPDATA%\WinStats and are not removed by Scoop.
